verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions provides self-hosted runner-based CI/CD with GitHub Actions-compatible YAML workflows (gitea-docs-2), and community evidence shows real-world usage pairing Gitea with self-hosted CI (Drone) for years, indicating a strong self-hosting ecosystem (gitea-comm-8, gitea-comm-14). However, no direct hands-on evidence specifically validates Gitea Actions' runner setup, reliability, or scaling, and other community notes emphasize Gitea historically stayed CI-agnostic, relying on external tools like Drone rather than native Actions.
